summary: Frontend-only verification of the AI chat widget after GEMINI_API_KEY was added to backend/.env. Loaded the homepage, opened the floating chat launcher, sent the Azerbaijani query 'Salam, kişi üçün klassik saat axtarıram', and observed a real, non-empty Azerbaijani assistant reply from Gemini within ~1s. No error strings present. Bug fix verified.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductService.getAll is called 12+ times on initial homepage load (see console), returning 1093 products each time. Consider memoization/react-query caching to avoid redundant fetches.
One 'Failed to load resource: net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED' error appears on load (unresolved third-party host) — investigate and remove or make it resilient.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI chat widget flow verified end-to-end at https://ai-chat-share-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Selectors used: ai-chat-launcher, ai-chat-panel, ai-chat-input, ai-chat-send, ai-chat-msg-assistant-*. First user send yields the assistant welcome + Gemini reply (msg count goes 0 -> 1 within ~1s). Backend /api/chat uses GEMINI_API_KEY + model gemini-flash-lite-latest.
rca of the issue: Original bug: chat returned 500 'Gemini API açarı konfiqurasiya edilməyib' because backend/.env was missing GEMINI_API_KEY on the preview instance. Fix (already applied by main agent): added GEMINI_API_KEY to backend/.env. Verification: chat widget now returns real Azerbaijani AI reply from gemini-flash-lite-latest — confirmed via UI flow.
